macos_identity_ok.summary: Set all three macOS identity values to the configured agentbox hostname.
macos_identity_ok.command: sudo /usr/sbin/scutil --set ComputerName {{expected_hostname}} && sudo /usr/sbin/scutil --set HostName {{expected_hostname}} && sudo /usr/sbin/scutil --set LocalHostName {{expected_hostname}}

headless_power_ok.summary: Restore the required headless power and automatic restart settings.

restart_freeze_ok.summary: Enable restart after a system freeze.

ssh_access_admin_user_ok.summary: Add the invoking admin user to the macOS SSH access group.

ssh_access_openclaw_user_ok.summary: Add the OpenClaw runner to the macOS SSH access group.

ssh_hardening_ok.summary: Reconcile `/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/agentbox.conf` with the original authorized-key inputs, then validate sshd before reloading it. A generic direct edit is unsafe.

openclaw_user_exists_ok.summary: Re-run the matching agentbox version with the original OpenClaw runner inputs. Account creation requires the runner password and cannot be repaired from health state alone.

openclaw_user_home_ok.summary: Reconcile the runner home through agentbox so the expected path, ownership, and skeleton files are restored together.

openclaw_user_non_admin_ok.summary: Remove the OpenClaw runner from the admin group only after confirming no unrelated workflow depends on that privilege.

openclaw_autologin_ok.summary: Re-run the matching agentbox version with the runner password available; macOS autologin configuration requires that secret input.

brewgroup_admin_user_ok.summary: Add the invoking admin user to the configured Homebrew group.

brewgroup_openclaw_user_ok.summary: Add the OpenClaw runner to the configured Homebrew group.

trusted_brewgroup_nested_ok.summary: Nest the configured trusted group into the Homebrew group.

brew_prefix_ok.summary: Restore group ownership and group read/write/traverse access across the Homebrew prefix.
brew_prefix_ok.command: sudo /usr/bin/find -x {{brew_prefix}} -exec chgrp -h {{brewgroup_expected}} {} + && sudo /usr/bin/find -x {{brew_prefix}} ! -type l -exec chmod g+rwX {} +

homebrew_login_path_file_ok.summary: Rewrite the managed login-path file with the Homebrew bin and sbin paths.

node_cli_ok.summary: Install or repair the Node.js formula required by OpenClaw.

openclaw_gateway_launchd_loaded_ok.summary: Bootstrap the existing managed OpenClaw gateway LaunchDaemon plist.

openclaw_gateway_launchd_running_ok.summary: Restart the managed OpenClaw gateway LaunchDaemon.

openclaw_gateway_log_permissions_ok.summary: Restore the managed gateway log directory and private runner-owned log files.
openclaw_gateway_log_permissions_ok.command: sudo /usr/bin/install -d -o root -g wheel -m 755 /var/log/tanaab/agentbox && sudo /usr/bin/touch /var/log/tanaab/agentbox/openclaw-gateway.stdout.log /var/log/tanaab/agentbox/openclaw-gateway.stderr.log && sudo /usr/sbin/chown {{openclaw_user}}:"$(/usr/bin/id -gn {{openclaw_user}})" /var/log/tanaab/agentbox/openclaw-gateway.stdout.log /var/log/tanaab/agentbox/openclaw-gateway.stderr.log && sudo /bin/chmod 600 /var/log/tanaab/agentbox/openclaw-gateway.stdout.log /var/log/tanaab/agentbox/openclaw-gateway.stderr.log

openclaw_gateway_status_ok.summary: The native user gateway requires a logged-in runner GUI session; restore that session or rerun agentbox in system service mode.

variants.summary: Restart the managed gateway, then inspect its private stderr log if readiness still fails.

tailscaled_launchd_loaded_ok.summary: Bootstrap the existing managed tailscaled LaunchDaemon plist.

tailscaled_homebrew_launchd_absent_ok.summary: Boot out the conflicting Homebrew system tailscaled service and remove its persistent plist.
tailscaled_homebrew_launchd_absent_ok.command: sudo /bin/launchctl bootout system/homebrew.mxcl.tailscale >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo /bin/launchctl bootout system /Library/LaunchDaemons/homebrew.mxcl.tailscale.plist >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo /bin/rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/homebrew.mxcl.tailscale.plist

tailscaled_homebrew_user_launchd_absent_.summary: Boot out the conflicting Homebrew user tailscaled service and remove its persistent plist.
tailscaled_homebrew_user_launchd_absent_.command: admin_user={{admin_user}}; admin_uid=$(/usr/bin/id -u "$admin_user") || exit 1; admin_home=$(/usr/bin/dscl . -read "/Users/$admin_user" NFSHomeDirectory | /usr/bin/awk '{$1=""; sub(/^ /, ""); print}') || exit 1; test -n "$admin_home" || exit 1; /bin/launchctl bootout "gui/${admin_uid}/homebrew.mxcl.tailscale" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; /bin/launchctl bootout "gui/${admin_uid}" "$admin_home/Library/LaunchAgents/homebrew.mxcl.tailscale.plist" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo /bin/rm -f "$admin_home/Library/LaunchAgents/homebrew.mxcl.tailscale.plist"

tailscaled_official_launchd_absent_ok.summary: Remove the conflicting official Tailscale app daemon and plist only after confirming the formula-based managed daemon is the intended installation.

tailscaled_state_file_ok.summary: Re-run Tailscale setup with the original auth key. The managed state file cannot be safely recreated from health output.

tailscale_operator_ok.summary: Set the OpenClaw runner as the Tailscale operator.

tailscale_magicdns_enabled.summary: Enable MagicDNS in the Tailscale DNS admin page, then rerun the doctor.

tailscale_magicdns_resolver_ok.summary: Restore the agentbox-managed scoped macOS resolver for the reported tailnet suffix.
tailscale_magicdns_resolver_ok.command: sudo /bin/mkdir -p /etc/resolver && printf '# Managed by agentbox.\nnameserver 100.100.100.100\n' | sudo /usr/bin/tee {{tailscale_magicdns_resolver_path}} >/dev/null && sudo /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel {{tailscale_magicdns_resolver_path}} && sudo /bin/chmod 644 {{tailscale_magicdns_resolver_path}}

tailscale_https_certificates_enabled.summary: Enable HTTPS certificates in the Tailscale DNS admin page, then rerun the doctor.

openclaw_gateway_tailscale_serve_route_o.summary: Restore the native user gateway's logged-in runner session so OpenClaw can reconcile its Tailscale Serve route.

variants.summary: Restart the managed gateway so OpenClaw can reconcile its Tailscale Serve route.

tailscale_firewall_warning.summary: Disable the macOS application firewall only if this host follows the agentbox tailnet-only exposure model.

health_launchd_loaded_ok.summary: Bootstrap the existing agentbox health LaunchDaemon plist.
